name: Auto-labeling (sensitivity labels)
short_description: Auto-labeling applies or recommends Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels automatically, either client-side in Office apps while content is created or service-side through policies that scan SharePoint, OneDrive and Exchange; service-side policies run in simulation before they are enforced.
